info.title: v2.merchant.get_merchant_prepaid_account_list
info.description: Use this api to get seller’s courier prepaid account.

get.description: Use this api to get seller’s courier prepaid account.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).

parameters.name: page_no
parameters.description: Specifies the page number of data to return in the current call. Starting from 1. if data is more than one page, the page_no can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Each result set is returned as a page of entries. Use the "page_size" filters to control the maximum number of entries to retrieve per page (i.e., per call), and the "page_no" to start next call. This integer value is used to specify the maximum number of entries to return in a single "page" of data. Min: 1 Max:10

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/merchant/get_merchant_prepaid_account_list?access_token=access_token&merchant_id=merchant_id&page_no=1&page_size=10&partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: prepaid_account_check_man
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Delivery Agent Name (电子面单承载快递员名).

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: prepaid_account_is_default
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is to indicate whether the prepaid account is Default Prepaid Account.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: more
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: This is to indicate whether the list is more than one page. If this value is true, you may want to continue to check next page to retrieve the rest of datas.
